title: Photo E-mail from the Clown
notes: Detective-cast (Kogoro Mouri, Conan, Ran, Takagi, Sato, Megure) omitted by convention, per ep011. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed edge between the entities involved. Cold-open theme-park scene is an unrelated gag involving no named plot character and is omitted. The old cases/ep424 file agreed on the culprit (Kijima) but was otherwise thin: it lumped Umeda's role with Kijima as 'blackmailed by his girlfriend' -- the transcript instead makes Umeda his professional mentor/discoverer who controlled his relationships by threatening to sabotage his career if he left her, not a girlfriend holding a secret over him. The old file also entirely missed the mechanics that make this episode's mystery work: the decoy clown doll swapped for the real corpse, the earthquake gas-shutoff device that accidentally exposed the true time of death, the balcony used as a cold-storage site to delay rigor mortis, the stolen phone used to send a fake photo e-mail to fabricate the victim being alive at 4:30pm, and the grey makeup/artificial-hair trace evidence from the body swap. It also gave Shimizu (the hired courier who was wrongly arrested) no distinguishing detail beyond a generic suspect slot. case_type: murder.

clues.desc: By 5:30pm in a heated room the body showed no rigor mortis, though the 4:30pm phone e-mail implied Umeda was alive an hour earlier -- the two facts contradict unless the body was kept cold somewhere else in between.

Fresh grey clown makeup on the balcony curtain plus a doll's wig-hair fiber by the ladder -- together they show the real and decoy bodies were swapped via the balcony, by someone who needed no outside access.
